_about: The one data file behind the per-stage status table in an export's README. export-flow.mjs reads it and FAILS if a command the flow ships has no row here. A status is a claim about what has actually been run, so a row changes only when a run changes it.

vocabulary.ran-from-export: Run from a generated export of this flow, and it worked.
vocabulary.source-only: Run in the private source repository this export is generated from (where the pipeline has shipped real sites), but never from an export.
vocabulary.not-run: No run is on record. It may work; nothing here says it does.

fallback.why: No run of this flow from an export is on record. Only content-sdk.greenfield.developer has been run, and only as far as the table of that repository says.

stages.summary: Read-only reconnaissance of the repository; writes one planning note.
stages.why: Ran from an earlier export and worked. Needs no tenant and no credentials.

stages.summary: Front door for new work that arrives as a prompt: asks the weight (PRD, FRD or bug) and dispatches.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Divergent brainstorming that ends in a concept brief, before any spec.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Scope questions, then a PRD, ADRs and a run manifest; chains into the spec review.
stages.why: Ran from an earlier export and worked. Needs no tenant; it creates a local git repository and branch for the product.

stages.summary: The same intake for a bounded feature: a feature spec instead of a full PRD.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: The same intake for a defect: a bug report, a failing regression test and a thin task list.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Cold-read gap analysis of the spec, then questions to the operator; carries the first hard stop.
stages.why: Chained from /create-prd. It runs in the private source; no separate record of an export run.

stages.summary: Read-only inventory of an existing SitecoreAI site, for builds that extend one.
stages.why: Needs a SitecoreAI tenant and credentials. No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Architecture blueprint and ADRs; sizes the deliverable and proposes a smaller first cut when it is large.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: One to three divergent UI variants as clickable prototypes, a fresh critic per prototype, and the design hard stop.
stages.why: Attempted from an earlier export and blocked, so it counts as not run from an export: the bare name /design collided with a Claude Code built-in, and the third-party design skills it loads are never published. This export tells you to type /project:design and gives install pointers and a fallback (.agent/packs/platform/content-sdk/reference/design-skills.md); that fix has not been re-run.

stages.summary: A task list with an execution contract and tests written first, split into component tranches.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Creates the SitecoreAI project pieces: a content-management environment, an editing host, a site, and the baseline code.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Needs a SitecoreAI organisation and an organisation-level automation client, and it changes a real tenant. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Builds one component tranche at a time against the task list, with probe tranches first.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Critical review of the change against the spec and the task list, then fixes.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Runs in the private source. The bare name collides with a Claude Code built-in: type /project:code-review.

stages.summary: Test execution and smoke checks, then fixes; the implement, review and test loop repeats up to five times.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Ship report, short README and changelog, then a commit, a push and a pull request. A human reviews and merges.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Needs a GitHub remote and the gh CLI; with a Vercel project it also sets the deployment variables. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Builds a visual map of the components a site really has, for the content author.
stages.why: Needs a running editing host that serves this run's code. No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Writes page content in the brand voice the spec defines and lands it on preview through the Marketer MCP.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Needs a SitecoreAI tenant and the Marketer MCP, and it writes to the tenant. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: An independent audit of the authored content as it renders; carries the final hard stop.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Needs the tenant and the editing host. Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: The one step that goes live: publishes, pulls the content back into git, redeploys on the live context, runs the delivery checks.
stages.why: Never run from an export. Needs the tenant, Vercel and credentials, and it changes a live site. Two helper scripts it cites are not shipped (see the stage). Runs in the private source.

stages.summary: Read-only health check of one SitecoreAI environment, site or page.
stages.why: Needs a tenant. No run from an export is on record. The bare name collides with a Claude Code built-in: type /project:doctor.

stages.summary: Read-only overview of every product: stage, branch, open gates.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record. The bare name collides with a Claude Code built-in: type /project:status.

stages.summary: Reconciles an interrupted run against what is on disk and in git, then continues.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record. The bare name collides with a Claude Code built-in: type /project:resume.

stages.summary: Confirms or refutes one load-bearing assumption against the real world before anything is built on it.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: On-demand research with sources, through the research sidecar agent.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Picks the next work item from a per-product queue file or from GitHub issues.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Drafts a commit message that follows the repository convention.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Deletes the generated planning artifacts of one product so you can start over.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record. Destructive for that product's planning folder.

stages.summary: A full documentation pass: README, architecture, decisions, changelog.
stages.why: No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Crawls a public site and records what a rebuild would have to match.
stages.why: Part of the clone flow only. No run from an export is on record.

stages.summary: Recreates an existing site on SitecoreAI from code or from an install package.
stages.why: Part of the clone flow only. No run from an export is on record.
